title: LLV-GBANKQ4-PURE: pure fourth-root sources with linear classical storage

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE physical LLV-GBANKQ4-PURE interpreter in proof.md executes the complete scoped GPS-Q4-PURE program in virtual.md, with selected d_root=4,beta=1/8,eta=1. It recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3 from independent ideal copies. The actual finite branch is n<2^256; otherwise u=ceil(n^(1/4)), ell=ceil(log2n), z=ceil(log2ell), b=ceil(3u^3(ell+2z+16)/2), m=ceil((n-1)/b), with all source/decoder/precision/acquisition/fallback quantities recomputed. Jointly on EVERY branch including failed work, discarded sources, wrong labels, both aborts, padded bank growth, source moves and cleanup, paid time T is O(2^((3/4)n^(3/4)log2n+n^(3/4)(log2n)^(1/8))) with exact growth index3/4. Absolute constants are independent of N,s and outcomes. The CQ simulation preserves the whole output law and source-request sequence. All basis/coherent/padded/source-moving wires, allocator/controller data and full addressing, arithmetic, initialization and cleanup work are counted. Current physical memory columns are not mixed with V allocations. The positive internal half-term pays all polynomial interpreter overhead. The four resources and clean fraction0 hold for this same configuration.
